panels.title: Charges
queries:
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  COALESCE(location, printf('%.4f, %.4f', latitude, longitude)) AS "Location",
  start_battery_level AS "% start",
  end_battery_level AS "% end",
  ROUND(charge_energy_added_kwh, 1) AS "kWh added",
  ROUND(charge_energy_used_kwh, 1) AS "kWh used (est.)",
  ROUND(max_charger_power_kw, 1) AS "max kW",
  ROUND(cost, 2) AS "cost",
  ROUND((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 24 * 60, 0) AS "min"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE status = 'closed'
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Energy recovered (kWh)
queries:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT power_kw,
         (julianday(LEAD(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp)) - julianday(timestamp)) * 86400 AS seconds
  FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND power_kw IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(power_kw * seconds / 3600.0), 0) * -1, 2) AS value
FROM d WHERE seconds > 0 AND seconds < 15 AND power_kw < 0

panels.title: Energy drawn (kWh)
queries:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT power_kw,
         (julianday(LEAD(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp)) - julianday(timestamp)) * 86400 AS seconds
  FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND power_kw IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(power_kw * seconds / 3600.0), 0), 2) AS value
FROM d WHERE seconds > 0 AND seconds < 15 AND power_kw > 0

panels.title: Elevation up / down
queries:
WITH steps AS (
  SELECT elevation_m - LAG(elevation_m) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS diff
  FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND elevation_m IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN diff > 0 THEN diff END), 0)
             * CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 3.28084 ELSE 1 END, 0)
       || ' ↑  ' ||
       ROUND(ABS(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN diff < 0 THEN diff END), 0))
             * CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 3.28084 ELSE 1 END, 0)
       || ' ↓ ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 'ft' ELSE 'm' END AS value
FROM steps

panels.title: Speed histogram ($length_unit/h)
queries:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (speed_kmh) / 1.60934 ELSE (speed_kmh) END / 10.0) * 10 AS band,
         (julianday(LEAD(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp)) - julianday(timestamp)) * 86400 AS seconds
  FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND speed_kmh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT band AS "Speed", ROUND(SUM(seconds), 0) AS "Seconds"
FROM d WHERE band > 0 AND seconds > 0 AND seconds < 15
GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

panels.title: Drives
queries:
SELECT
  id AS drive_id,
  CAST(strftime('%s', start_time) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS start_epoch,
  CAST(strftime('%s', end_time) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS end_epoch,
  start_time AS time,
  COALESCE(start_location, printf('%.4f, %.4f', start_lat, start_lng)) AS "From",
  COALESCE(end_location, printf('%.4f, %.4f', end_lat, end_lng)) AS "To",
  ROUND(distance_km, 1) AS "km",
  ROUND(duration_min, 0) AS "min",
  start_battery_level AS "% start",
  end_battery_level AS "% end",
  ROUND(max_speed_kmh, 0) AS "max km/h",
  ROUND(ascent_m, 0) AS "ascent m",
  ROUND(descent_m, 0) AS "descent m"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed'
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Ø Consumption (net) (Wh/$length_unit)
queries:
SELECT SUM((d.$start_range - d.$end_range) * v.efficiency_wh_km)
       / NULLIF(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (SUM(d.distance_km)) / 1.60934 ELSE (SUM(d.distance_km)) END, 0) AS value
FROM drives d JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = d.vehicle_id
WHERE d.status = 'closed'
  AND d.distance_km IS NOT NULL
  AND d.$start_range - d.$end_range >= 0.1
  AND d.start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Ø Consumption (gross) (Wh/$length_unit)
queries:
SELECT (
WITH events AS (
  SELECT 'drive_start' AS event, start_time AS time, $start_range AS range FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'drive_end', COALESCE(end_time, start_time), $end_range FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_start', start_time, $start_range FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_end', COALESCE(end_time, start_time), $end_range FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
), ordered AS (
  SELECT event, range, LEAD(range) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_range FROM events WHERE range IS NOT NULL
), losses AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN event = 'drive_start' THEN range - next_range
           WHEN range - next_range > 0 THEN range - next_range
           ELSE 0
         END AS loss
  FROM ordered WHERE next_range IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(loss), 0) * (SELECT efficiency_wh_km FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) FROM losses) / NULLIF((SELECT CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (MAX(end_odometer_km) - MIN(start_odometer_km)) / 1.60934 ELSE (MAX(end_odometer_km) - MIN(start_odometer_km)) END FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')), 0) AS value

panels.title: Logged Distance ($length_unit)
queries: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (SUM(distance_km)) / 1.60934 ELSE (SUM(distance_km)) END FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')) AS value

panels.title: Temperature – Driving Efficiency
queries:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'C'
              THEN ROUND(d.outside_temp_avg_c / 5.0) * 5
              ELSE ROUND((d.outside_temp_avg_c * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32) / 10.0) * 10
         END AS bucket,
         SUM(d.$start_range - d.$end_range) AS total_range,
         SUM(d.distance_km) AS total_distance,
         SUM(d.duration_min) AS duration
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.status = 'closed'
    AND d.distance_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.outside_temp_avg_c IS NOT NULL
    AND CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (d.distance_km) / 1.60934 ELSE (d.distance_km) END >= $min_distance
    AND d.$start_range - d.$end_range > 0.1
    AND d.start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT bucket AS "Outside temp (°$temp_unit)",
       ROUND(total_distance / NULLIF(total_range, 0), 3) AS "Efficiency",
       ROUND(total_range / NULLIF(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (total_distance) / 1.60934 ELSE (total_distance) END, 0) * (SELECT efficiency_wh_km FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 0) AS "Consumption (Wh/$length_unit)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (total_distance) / 1.60934 ELSE (total_distance) END, 1) AS "Driven ($length_unit)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (total_distance) / 1.60934 ELSE (total_distance) END / NULLIF(duration, 0) * 60, 1) AS "Ø speed ($length_unit/h)"
FROM t
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Derived ideal efficiencies (Wh/$length_unit)
queries:
SELECT ROUND(charge_energy_added_kwh
              / NULLIF(end_ideal_range_km - start_ideal_range_km, 0)
              / CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 1.0 / 1.60934 ELSE 1 END, 3) * 1000 AS "efficiency_$length_unit",
       COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE status = 'closed'
  AND (julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 1440 > 10
  AND end_battery_level <= 95
  AND start_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND end_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND charge_energy_added_kwh > 0
GROUP BY 1
HAVING "efficiency_$length_unit" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 3

panels.title: Derived rated efficiencies (Wh/$length_unit)
queries:
SELECT ROUND(charge_energy_added_kwh
              / NULLIF(end_range_km - start_range_km, 0)
              / CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 1.0 / 1.60934 ELSE 1 END, 3) * 1000 AS "efficiency_$length_unit",
       COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE status = 'closed'
  AND (julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 1440 > 10
  AND end_battery_level <= 95
  AND start_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND end_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND charge_energy_added_kwh > 0
GROUP BY 1
HAVING "efficiency_$length_unit" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 3

panels.title: # of Addresses
queries:
WITH visited AS (
  SELECT start_location AS name, start_time AS at FROM drives
    WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_location IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT end_location, end_time FROM drives
    WHERE status = 'closed' AND end_location IS NOT NULL AND end_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT location, start_time FROM charging_sessions
    WHERE status = 'closed' AND location IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS value FROM visited

    WHERE status = 'closed' AND end_location IS NOT NULL AND end_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT location, start_time FROM charging_sessions
    WHERE status = 'closed' AND location IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
), addresses AS (
  SELECT name, MAX(road) AS road, MAX(city) AS city, MAX(county) AS county,
         MAX(state) AS state, MAX(postcode) AS postcode, MAX(country) AS country
  FROM geocode_cache GROUP BY name
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) AS value
FROM visited v JOIN addresses a ON a.name = v.name
WHERE a.city IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL SELECT 'Efficiency', 'Derived efficiency figures'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Mileage', 'Cumulative odometer'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Updates', 'Software update history'

panels.title: Projected Range - Mileage
queries:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT p.timestamp, p.$pos_range AS range, p.usable_battery_level AS soc,
         p.odometer_km AS odometer, p.outside_temp_c AS temp
  FROM positions p
  WHERE p.usable_battery_level > 0 AND p.$pos_range > 0
    AND p.battery_level = p.usable_battery_level
    AND p.timestamp >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cs.timestamp, cs.$pos_range, cs.usable_battery_level,
         (SELECT MAX(d.end_odometer_km) FROM drives d WHERE d.end_time <= cs.timestamp),
         NULL
  FROM charging_samples cs
  WHERE cs.usable_battery_level > 0 AND cs.$pos_range > 0
    AND cs.battery_level = cs.usable_battery_level
    AND cs.timestamp >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
)
SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (odometer) / 1.60934 ELSE (odometer) END, 0) AS "Odometer ($length_unit)",
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (range * 100.0 / soc) / 1.60934 ELSE (range * 100.0 / soc) END), 1) AS "Projected range ($length_unit)"
FROM samples
WHERE odometer IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Projected Range - Battery Level
queries:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT p.timestamp, p.$pos_range AS range, p.usable_battery_level AS soc,
         p.odometer_km AS odometer, p.outside_temp_c AS temp
  FROM positions p
  WHERE p.usable_battery_level > 0 AND p.$pos_range > 0
    AND p.battery_level = p.usable_battery_level
    AND p.timestamp >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cs.timestamp, cs.$pos_range, cs.usable_battery_level,
         (SELECT MAX(d.end_odometer_km) FROM drives d WHERE d.end_time <= cs.timestamp),
         NULL
  FROM charging_samples cs
  WHERE cs.usable_battery_level > 0 AND cs.$pos_range > 0
    AND cs.battery_level = cs.usable_battery_level
    AND cs.timestamp >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
)
SELECT soc AS "Battery level (%)",
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (range * 100.0 / soc) / 1.60934 ELSE (range * 100.0 / soc) END), 1) AS "Projected range ($length_unit)"
FROM samples
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Projected Range - Outdoor Temp
queries:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT p.timestamp, p.$pos_range AS range, p.usable_battery_level AS soc,
         p.odometer_km AS odometer, p.outside_temp_c AS temp
  FROM positions p
  WHERE p.usable_battery_level > 0 AND p.$pos_range > 0
    AND p.battery_level = p.usable_battery_level
    AND p.timestamp >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cs.timestamp, cs.$pos_range, cs.usable_battery_level,
         (SELECT MAX(d.end_odometer_km) FROM drives d WHERE d.end_time <= cs.timestamp),
         NULL
  FROM charging_samples cs
  WHERE cs.usable_battery_level > 0 AND cs.$pos_range > 0
    AND cs.battery_level = cs.usable_battery_level
    AND cs.timestamp >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'C' THEN ROUND(temp) ELSE ROUND(temp * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32) END AS "Outside temp (°$temp_unit)",
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (range * 100.0 / soc) / 1.60934 ELSE (range * 100.0 / soc) END), 1) AS "Projected range ($length_unit)"
FROM samples
WHERE temp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Current State
queries: SELECT state AS value FROM states ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Last state change
queries: SELECT started_at AS value FROM states ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: parked (%)
queries:
SELECT (1 - SUM(duration_min)
             / NULLIF((julianday(MAX(end_time)) - julianday(MIN(start_time))) * 1440, 0)) * 100 AS value
FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: States
queries:
SELECT started_at AS time, state AS "State"
FROM states
WHERE started_at >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Recent state changes
queries:
SELECT started_at AS "Time", state AS "State", ended_at AS "Ended",
       ROUND((julianday(COALESCE(ended_at, datetime('now'))) - julianday(started_at)) * 1440, 1) AS "Duration (min)"
FROM states
WHERE started_at >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Time in each state
queries:
SELECT state AS "State",
       ROUND(SUM(julianday(COALESCE(ended_at, datetime('now'))) - julianday(started_at)) * 24, 2) AS "Hours"
FROM states
WHERE started_at >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Per $period
queries:
WITH drive_stats AS (
  SELECT CASE '$period'
    WHEN 'day'   THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d', d.start_time)
    WHEN 'week'  THEN strftime('%Y-W%W', d.start_time)
    WHEN 'year'  THEN strftime('%Y', d.start_time)
    ELSE strftime('%Y-%m', d.start_time)
  END AS period,
         SUM(d.duration_min) AS minutes,
         SUM(d.distance_km) AS distance_km,
         AVG(d.outside_temp_avg_c) AS temp_c,
         COUNT(*) AS drives,
         SUM(d.$start_range - d.$end_range) AS range_diff,
         SUM((d.$start_range - d.$end_range) * v.efficiency_wh_km) AS energy_wh
  FROM drives d JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = d.vehicle_id
  WHERE d.status = 'closed' AND d.start_time >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
  GROUP BY 1
), charge_stats AS (
  SELECT CASE '$period'
    WHEN 'day'   THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%d', start_time)
    WHEN 'week'  THEN strftime('%Y-W%W', start_time)
    WHEN 'year'  THEN strftime('%Y', start_time)
    ELSE strftime('%Y-%m', start_time)
  END AS period,
         COUNT(*) AS charges,
         SUM(charge_energy_added_kwh) AS added_kwh,
         SUM(MAX(COALESCE(charge_energy_added_kwh, 0), COALESCE(charge_energy_used_kwh, 0))) AS used_kwh,
         SUM(cost) AS cost
  FROM charging_sessions
  WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
    AND (charge_energy_added_kwh IS NULL OR charge_energy_added_kwh > 0)
  GROUP BY 1
), periods AS (
  SELECT period FROM drive_stats UNION SELECT period FROM charge_stats
)
SELECT p.period AS "Period",
       ROUND(d.minutes, 0) AS "Minutes driven",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (d.distance_km) / 1.60934 ELSE (d.distance_km) END, 1) AS "Driven ($length_unit)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'C' THEN d.temp_c ELSE d.temp_c * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32 END, 1) AS "Ø temp (°$temp_unit)",
       d.drives AS "# of drives",
       ROUND(d.distance_km / NULLIF(d.range_diff, 0) * 100, 0) AS "Efficiency %",
       ROUND(d.energy_wh / NULLIF(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (d.distance_km) / 1.60934 ELSE (d.distance_km) END, 0), 0) AS "Consumption (Wh/$length_unit)",
       c.charges AS "# of charges",
       ROUND(c.added_kwh, 1) AS "Energy added (kWh)",
       ROUND(c.used_kwh, 1) AS "Energy used (kWh)",
       ROUND(c.used_kwh / NULLIF(c.charges, 0), 1) AS "Ø per charge (kWh)",
       ROUND(c.cost, 2) AS "Cost"
FROM periods p
LEFT JOIN drive_stats d ON d.period = p.period
LEFT JOIN charge_stats c ON c.period = p.period
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: State timeline
queries: SELECT started_at AS time, state AS "State" FROM states ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Time in each state (7d)
queries:
SELECT
  state AS "State",
  COUNT(*) AS "Transitions",
  ROUND(SUM((julianday(COALESCE(ended_at, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))) - julianday(started_at)) * 24), 1) AS "Total hours"
FROM states
WHERE started_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY "Total hours" DESC

panels.title: Updates
queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM software_updates WHERE status = 'installed'

panels.title: Median days between updates
queries:
WITH gaps AS (
  SELECT (julianday(start_time) - julianday(LAG(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time))) AS days
  FROM software_updates
  WHERE status = 'installed'
), ordered AS (
  SELECT days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY days) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM gaps WHERE days IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT days AS value FROM ordered WHERE rn = (n + 1) / 2

panels.title: Current version
queries:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT firmware_version FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),
              (SELECT version FROM software_updates WHERE status = 'installed' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)) AS value

panels.title: Update history
queries:
SELECT start_time AS "Started", version AS "Version", status AS "Status", end_time AS "Finished",
       ROUND((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 1440, 1) AS "Install (min)",
       ROUND(julianday(start_time) - julianday(LAG(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time)), 1) AS "Days since previous"
FROM software_updates
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Vampire drain
queries:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    battery_level,
    battery_range_km,
    LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_ts,
    LAG(battery_level) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_level,
    LAG(battery_range_km) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_range
  FROM battery_samples
)
SELECT
  prev_ts AS time,
  timestamp AS "End",
  ROUND((julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24, 1) AS "Period (h)",
  prev_level AS "Start %",
  battery_level AS "End %",
  (battery_level - prev_level) AS "SoC diff",
  ROUND(prev_range - battery_range_km, 2) AS "Range loss (km)",
  ROUND((prev_range - battery_range_km) / ((julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24), 2) AS "km lost / h"
FROM samples
WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24 >= $min_idle_hours
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drives WHERE start_time > prev_ts AND start_time < timestamp)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charging_sessions WHERE start_time > prev_ts AND start_time < timestamp)
  AND ABS(battery_level - prev_level) <= 15
ORDER BY prev_ts DESC
LIMIT 200
